object.name: evi.allpass~
object.description: Cubic interpolated allpass filter delay unit. The same structure as MSP <o>allpass~</o>, but with cubic interpolation for smoother high end decays, and a tamed gain coefficient so no digital clipping or aliasing. Quite different than MSP. This abstraction also includes an optional <m>feedbackmix</m> attribute which does ridiculous nonlinear comb effects (default off).
object.discussion: For more information about other reimplementations of MSP filters in evieve, see the 'evieve msp' tab of the helpfile.

inlets.description: Not smoothed internally. Applies negative or positive gain to the feedforward and feedback paths.

attributes.name: feedbackmix
attributes.description: If > 0, applies saturating gain stage to the internal feedback path.
